pattern: Persistent worker organized under its orchestrator
experience: Independent launched threads cluttered the sidebar because they had no organizational parent.
rule: Use groupingParentThreadId for organization while preserving independent launch semantics.
prompt: Create one new independent thread for the CSV export timezone fix and nest it under this orchestrator in the sidebar. This thread ID is 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333. Keep it independently runnable; do not delegate a task. Do not fix the code here.
notes: Organizational nesting must not turn an independently launched thread into a delegated task.
